title: Veil of Echoes
tagline: Return to your eerie hometown in Veil of Echoes, Using a mysterious radio, unravel spectral distortions and hidden truths from an abandoned facility. Navigate reality and the supernatural where every choice echoes through time. Can you unveil the past to save your future?
description: Veil of Echoes is an on-chain interactive thriller that immerses players in a mysterious journey back to their eerie hometown. Integrating StarkNet, the game leverages blockchain technology to enhance immersion and permanence. Players use Argent and Braavos wallets to manage in-game assets and progress, earning exclusive NFTs as they successfully navigate through checkpoints and uncover the town's secrets. Each decision echoes through the blockchain, rewarding those who can unveil the past and secure the future.
how_its_made: Veil of Echoes is developed using Next.js for the front-end and styled with Tailwind CSS for modern, responsive design. We deploy smart contracts using SN Foundry, ensuring secure and efficient on-chain interactions. With the integration of Scaffold-Stark-2, we connect seamlessly to StarkNet, enabling player interactions via Argent and Braavos wallets, and reward completions with NFTs.
